reviews.text: Amazing service. We had an emergency on a Saturday morning and they managed to book us in with very short notice. After that, the vet and team kept us updated all the time, and gave us very close communication about the progress

Such amazing care for my cat. He was limping and had to visit during off hours. The staff were incredibly helpful with organising an appointment. My cat is aggressive at the vet. Alice was incredibly professional and was able to get him sedated to have a look at an injury. They provided an accurate cost up front and communicated well start to finish. I would absolutely recommend this vet practice again and again!
Attentive staff, great weekend service. Pricing is a bit more premium but worth it for a quality service. From receptionist to vet, a well organised and helpful vet. Will be our new local go to

Completely over priced. £1700 for a gastrointestinal issue that required me to go back 3 times for it to actually get fixed and find out they wanted to charge me an additional £250 on top of that for faecal tests. £1600 for my cat who really only needed a scan on his arm but they suddenly needed to ensure I got a lung scan, sedation and have the cat stay in for the day. When you question them, they tell you there is no other option. I get that they want to make money but this is terrible practise and quite frankly appalling. I won’t be going back because they are only interested in upselling. Both times my cat came home unclean, they didn’t even bother to wipe the blood off his nose after his fall. £4000 not well spent.
A really great vet. Took in my poor cat that had been run over and handed in by a stranger. They are great at informing you in detail about everything and the vet itself is very nice

Refused to even look at a dog that was rescued from drowning in the Thames by two fire brigades literally 5 mins from the vet. This was around 22:30 pm, but vet is 24/7. Fire brigade were even ready to take the dog to the vet. Could have spent 5 mins checking if dog was ok in the hall. There was no need to keep the dog in the vet, as it would've been transported to a rescue shelter afterwards. So 4 passers-by, two fire brigades and a rescue boat decided it was important to save the poor dog, but this 24/7 vet get could not be bothered to spend 5 mins on same dog which would be delivered to its doors by the fire engine. Shame on you!

Very disappointing experience with the clinic, especially from a service advertised as 24-hour emergency care.

A dog had just been rescued from the River Thames at 10.30pm by the fire brigade nearby, and the firefighters called to ask if the dog could be brought in for a quick check-up. The clinic refused to see the dog, and the lady on the phone was quite annoyed and even raised her voice at the firefighter.

Given the circumstances, I expected much more professionalism and compassion from an emergency veterinary clinic.

Their vets are attentive and friendly and facilities look excellent. If you have pets who are friendly and relaxed about visiting vets and you have big pockets with limitless budget, Wolfe Vets could be good for you.
My issue is their priority which seems to be business and money more than animal welfare. They are not at all prepared to adapt their own company policy to individual animal needs. Their justification is unreasonable and illogical to me (hopefully to many others, too). Please beware that they insist on the 6-monthly physical exam of your pet, not annual if you need repeat prescription of flea/worm treatment. Initially I was told that it's a UK law by their administrator but it was a false statement because according to the RCVS rules, anti-parasite prescription meds can be dispensed at intervals up to 12 months without repeated physical exams and their guidance also state the importance of not stressing animals.
6-monthly mandatory checkup is Wolfe Vets own company policy. When I registered my cat with them, I wasn't informed of this and there's no statement of this policy on their website. Upon registration I repeatedly explained to their vet that I can only cope with an annual checkup for vaccination and flea treatment since my cat is nervous and doesn't like vets at all. I also told them I would need to give a mild sedative to take him to vets for check ups. Still, he will keep crying throughout his journey to the vet. They know this fact when they accepted my registration. Vet's visit is very stressful for my old cat who only let a vet to touch him for less than 5 minutes. Still, Wolfe Vets insists I bring him for a very brief check up just for repeat prescription of flea treatment. Total cost  is £150 (+ Uber taxi fares). But it is not about the cost. I don't want to keep giving a sedative to my 14-year old cat and stress him out for a 5-minutes checkup. The fact that this vet can't adapt their policy (not UK law) to individual pets' needs is the sign that they care more for business and  money than animals' welfare. I had to move to a family-run vet (not corporate run) who is happy to see my cat for an annual checkup for vaccination and 12-month worth anti-parasite treatment. They even offer an option of a home visit for a checkup if my cat finds it less stressful at less than Wolfe Vets' cost. There are vets who prioritise animal welfare more than their business.

Fantastic vets and staff. We feel valued and know that our pet is in the best hands. Having the emergency service at the same place as our usual appointments is not only convenient for us but reduces stress for our pet. Staff truly care and go above and beyond to help us

Took Monty here as he fractured his dew claw on a bank holiday and they provide the emergency service for his normal vets. Called at 8am, got an appointment at 9am and brought him home at 1pm, lovely practice and the team there were excellent, highly recommend
Thank you for your review. :)

Absolutely Outstanding Team

I honestly cannot recommends Wolfe practice highly enough. Every single person I’ve dealt with has been absolutely amazing, kind, caring, professional and genuinely compassionate.

It’s rare to come across a team where every single member is so wonderful, and I’ve never experienced anything quite like it before. They always make Bowie feel safe and cared for, and they’ve been incredibly reassuring and helpful every step of the way.

A truly exceptional team who clearly love what they do. Thank you all so much for taking such great care of Bowie! ❤️🐾
Thank you for your review

I have found the Wolfe Pak a huge benefit.   I have an old dog who lately has had several little and one big problem.   All have been dealt with expertly and without any delay.   I think the Wolfe Pak is brilliant
So happy this amazing practice has arrived in Fulham. Excellent service, warm and welcoming & most importantly they genuinely care.

My cat has been part of the Wolfe Pack for mor than two years now and the convenience can't be over-estimated. From reminders for check-ups and treatments, to not worrying about paying at the counter, it just makes my life much easier.

One of the worst vet experiences I’ve had.

The prices are already outrageous, but what really disappointed me was being pressured into an expensive vaccine that made no sense in my situation.

My dog travelled over a year ago and has been seen by this same clinic multiple times since, including an overnight stay. Nobody had ever mentioned this vaccine before. Yet this vet insisted that if I didn’t get it, most vets wouldn’t see my dog, which was simply not true.

I repeatedly said I didn’t want the vaccine, but she kept pushing it. I left feeling pressured and like scare tactics were being used instead of honest advice.

I won’t be coming back.
Great Clinic, Dr Jonathan did our cat dental surgery and the whole process was super and staff really helpful.
Catherine there was amazing. Honestly what a hire. She saw us immediately and went the extra mile. Can’t say good enough things about her.
Happy to see that they take care of our pets with big attention.

I am very happy with Wolfe Vets.  Otto is enrolled in the Wolfe Pack so we can get free parasite and worming treatment and unlimited free consultations.
All the vets are kind and friendly and have handled Otto sensitively which is important because he has become more nervous as he's got older.
Brilliant
With Wolfe Vets, I feel confident that my pets are under reliable protection every moment of their lives. That’s wonderful feeling. Many thanks to the entire team of professionals for that👍 …

Today we had our annual appointment for vaccination. Dr. Natascha Hedegaard was our doctor. We had a wonderful experience with her. She has been very friendly, supportive and patient towards my limitless quesitons :) She has taken her time to explain us every single detail clearly. I strongly suggest Wolfe Vets, and Dr. Natascha Hedegaard.

I received fantastic, fast, and reliable service for my cat’s dental work. The environment is pleasant, and the staff is incredibly friendly. A huge thank you to Jonathan and the reception team for welcoming Mila and me so warmly!

We recently had a middle-of-the-night emergency with our 11-year-old cat, Nasa, when she suddenly developed severe breathing difficulties, including persistent open-mouth breathing. Wolfe Vets was listed on our regular vet’s emergency hotline, so we called immediately. Our call was answered by an emergency nurse who gave clear, calm instructions on what to do.

When we arrived, Nasa was struggling to breathe very badly. The night vet and nurse were incredibly proactive and acted straight away to stabilise her. Afterwards, both the night vet and nurse were incredibly calm, knowledgeable and empathetic to us on how we will tackle this situation. Their professionalism made us feel a little more at ease during a stressful situation.

Nasa ended up staying for five nights in intensive care, which was very tough for her and an extremely anxious time for both me and my husband. I cannot thank the vets and nurses enough for the care they gave her. They treated Nasa with such kindness and compassion, and were deeply attentive to her wellbeing while doing everything they could to help her recover. They also kept us consistently updated, both the day and night teams called regularly with updates and guided us through this very difficult time.

It was reassuring to see Nasa gradually become more comfortable with the vets and nurses during her stay. That gave us real confidence that she was surrounded by people who genuinely care about animals and had her best interests at heart.

Thanks to the incredible team at Wolfe Vets, Nasa was finally discharged after five nights. We are so relieved and grateful that she received such outstanding care. I truly cannot thank the team enough.

Our dog had injured his foot so I was really worried. We managed to get a booking with the out of hours. He got a pain shot which knocked his socks off and he was dazed for days but came out of it fine and a funny story for us, seeing him out of it.

Very impressed.
Lots of good advice and explanations from the vet. Didn’t feel pushed into accepting treatments and other commodities.

Wolfe Vets is a centre of veterinary excellence. From arranging the initial appointment through to discharge, the entire experience was outstanding. As a referral client, I was treated as though both my pet and I had been long-standing patients, which immediately put us at ease.
The team went above and beyond and their kindness and professionalism are evident in every interaction. Dr Jonathan Frost is an exemplary veterinary surgeon. He took the time to provide a thoughtful and thorough consultation, carried out the dental treatment with great care and skill and kept me fully informed throughout the day right up to discharge. His care and professionalism were  second to none. I couldn’t recommend Wolfe Vets highly enough.Thank you.
Very good and professional Vets

We recently had to take our beagle in for an emergency procedure after he managed to eat an entire peach, which required an endoscopy to remove it. From the first call with Charlotte at reception through to collecting him with Karl, our experience at Wolfe Vet Fulham was excellent.

Every member of the team was calm, kind and acutely aware of how stressful it is when your dog is facing a health issue. The situation was explained clearly and thoroughly, including the risks, the procedure itself and what to expect afterwards. We felt informed at every stage, never rushed, and genuinely supported.

It makes a significant difference to be treated not just as a case, but as worried owners who care deeply about their little companion. We are very grateful for the professionalism and empathy shown throughout, and would not hesitate to recommend them.
My family and I went to the Wolfe Vets emergency service for our sick elderly dog. They were professional and very understanding and have us all the information to make a very difficult decision

My beloved cat was treated at the hospital. He was admitted very quickly as emergency, and there were no delays. From the first call, the staff was lovely and really supportive, and helped me going through the stress. Sadly, I lost my cat, and all the team was utmost professional, and compassionate. Truly remarkable and kind team.
Xmas Eve with sick cat. Wolfe Vets are seriously  good, but vet charges in the UK are just horrendous.
An excellent customer approach, I had seen Dr Leo few times but when I needed an advice, as he was away,  another Vet lady called me very soon and helped me.

I was feeling anxious and upset when I visited the practice recently but I really should not have worried! I was met by a young lady ( I think her name was Charlotte?)  She was so calm, and compassionate and really put me at ease - this is what you call a good customer experience - I don’t normally write reviews but the professional and calm service I received, made such a difference to me.
The whole team at Wolfe are amazing. Outstanding clinical skill with genuine empathy, never rushing clients and always taking time to help on a one to level. Thoughtful follow-ups and clear communication set them apart and inspire real trust, loyalty and gratitude. A big big five stars from me.

My poor cat, Dave, fell in the recent winter cold weather, where there was a lot of ice and misjudged where to jump. We quickly called our Chiswick branch and they advised it was best to go to the Fulham site as it was 24 hours.

Dave was seen too immediately as pre-arranged appointment as emergency, was given diagnosed and course of remedies. I was given a very good outline of the services needed and costs involved, I agreed and treatment was done immediately.

Collect Dave a couple of days later with Dave in a cast and meds given with details. As I went back home, Dave did not like the cage he was going in and took off his cast, I went back to the Fulham branch giving an explanation and it was agreed to keep Dave in another 4 nights.

The 24 hour care that Wolfe Fulham provides is both invaluable and a standard apart from most other veterinary services.

The experienced and dedicated staff took care of my dog in the days before Christmas, in the most acute circumstances, and whilst I was sadly far away. In previous years (with another dog), I was not able to find that level of professional staff, 24 hour care/facilities, and the latest equipment anywhere nearby. Without them, I know Christmas would not have been the same. I am so grateful that both the emergency hospital and the regular everyday care of Wolfe vets are here in West London.

We are so grateful to the team at Wolfe for providing round the clock critical care for our kitten. He was treated with enormous tender loving care and we now have a happy healthy kitten so thank you Wolfe 🙏 …
After first experience where my dog turned into a total demon, today he was absolutely perfect with Dr Karl Leo. ❤

My Freddy got attacked by a fox on Xmas day took him to Wolfe vets wandworh bridge road
The service I received from the whole staff working I cannot fault they showed so much professionalism I would recommend this surgery to all animal lovers all I have to say is thank you

Thank you for your review. 

Kind regards,
The team at Wolfe Vets

I can’t thank the Wolfe vets team enough for saving my little Sasha after an unfortunate accident. I knew she was in good hands and the team reassured me along the way while she had to stay over at the clinic for a couple of days. She was very loved and very well looked after. And the best part is she seems to have fully recovered and is now back to her happy confident self. Thanks again for saving my little one 🩷

Absolutely fantastic staff, the most caring, wonderful and skilled people one could want to examine your pets. Really goo value and really professional in every aspect. 1000% recommend.. massive thank you Minty, Karl, Charlotte, Cindy, Jo.

A great team at Wolfe Vets, ladies at reception are always very welcoming so are all the vets. Special thanks to Alonso for assisting with all the travels requirements for my two dogs. Would highly recommend!
Great team caring for your pets! Paulina and charlotte are adorable, always kind with Taïga, giving her cuddles and treats! Also very helpful with practical recommendations! I warmly recommend

I love all of the staff at Wolfe Vets in Fulham …everyone is so kind and caring. After my cat died earlier in the year, they provided a safe haven for me …and looked after us both with such compassion🙏

Since I acquired my kitten, all the nurses and  vets have been so loving and attentive .. in particular; Paulina has developed a very sweet, special relationship with her.

Thank you to all …it is wonderful to know you are close by to where I live ..and always so welcoming and accommodating.

Wolfe vets have been taking care of our cats for over a year now and we are delighted with the care our fur babies get. One of our cats recently had to undergo a surgery and she was spoilt by Angela - this gave us such peace of mind when we could not be with our cat
Great job for Dr Alonso and Miss Paulina. We are very happy about the care provided for our dogs Sasha and Dixie. 😊 …

ive been coming here for over a year and have only had a lovely experience! The vets are amazing, gentle and informative. I have 4 animals and I know they are in the best hands when they’re here (and I’ve been to a lot of different vets!)
Friendly and knowledgeable vets on call 24 hours - A special mention to Charlotte for being lovely and helpful thank you

My dog Lonzo had such fantastic care for his 2 nights at Wolfe vets. The phone calls with all the nurses were informative and reassuring and on collecting him the vet on call called Alonso (coincidentally!) was fantastic. I feel confident that my dog has had the best veterinary care and now I’m ready to take him home. Thank you Wolfe vets!

Updated Oct 2025 : My 15 year old dog was struggling to breathe was diagnosed wihr pulmonary hypertension. Alonso, Dulcie and team quickly performed the necessary scans , gave oxygen treatment and diagnosed his underlying condition and prescribed the medication required. My dog lived for another 7 months on the medication so his life was extended for a considerable time considering his age. Thank you to the vets and team once again.
This is a superb, modern surgery providing excellent and thoughtful care.
Very happy with the service provided by Aimee , the vet doctor, she handled my difficult dog perfectly and managed to examine him and do all necessary things for him . I strongly recommend !
Wolfe vets Fulham have been great for my cat. They are open long hours and are always helpful. We never have to wait long and I would definitely recommend them!

We took our cat Leia late at night. She is super shy (and scared of leaving home). The vet (Claudia) and the receptionist were super kind. Claudia listened patiently to our worries, answered our questions, and treated Leia with care and kindness.

I went for my first initial check-up with all 3 of my rescue dogs. We received excellent care. The Wolfe Pack they offer is an amazing deal. My 3 rescues (from America) don’t qualify for pet insurance here so I have always paid full price for their vet bills. My eldest dog is 16 (estimated age) and has a lot of health issues. The other two have a heart condition. As you can imagine, the vet bills are ££££££££ for my 3 rescues. The Wolfe Pack brings their bill down by a fair amount.
I’m really shocked about some other reviews on here stating the vet only cares about money. This is the last thing I feel from them. I feel all the vets here genuinely care about my dogs. I’m always greeted with a smile and the reception team know my dogs.

I recommend Wolfe Vets 100%.

We couldn’t have chosen a better veterinary clinic for our Chihuahua, Lola. It has been a year since she became part of our family and we have trusted Wolfe Vets ever since. Dr. Alonso is truly exceptional. He is very professional, patient and always takes the time to explain everything in detail. He even remembers Lola and her previous visits, which makes us feel very confident in his care. One of the biggest advantages is that he speaks Spanish, which is incredibly helpful for those of us whose first language is not English and sometimes struggle to explain exactly what is wrong with our pets.

Also Dr Karl, the nurses and reception team are also wonderful. They are kind, attentive and provide excellent customer service. Honestly, one of the best things about moving here has been finding such a great veterinary team to care for Lola whenever she needs it. Thank you so much, Wolfe Vets!

If I could give this place -10 stars, I would. Absolutely disgusting how this clinic puts money before the wellbeing of animals. They tried to push my dog into unnecessary sedation and surgery — something that wasn’t needed at all — just to charge me nearly £1,000. Putting a dog under that kind of stress without cause is unacceptable and should be reported. On top of that, they wanted me to pay for an antibiotic injection in the meantime. The whole thing felt like a money grab. Reception staff were miserable and unhelpful when I was registering my dog— I had to drag information out of them. I left feeling sick at how dishonest and unethical this clinic is. I would never trust them with any animal.

My cat had 14 teeth removed by an amazing dental surgeon at Fulham branch. Having suffered from  severe gingivitis and stomatitis, that unfortunately had been the only avenue. None of the meds, laser had helped. Fast forward to today, over a year after the surgery, Max is thriving and bouncing two-year-old boy. Thank you so much for your professionalism and empathy.

Absolutely terrifying place! I used this vets bcs they partner with Pickles vets Fulham for after hours services. And what a terrible care we had! Stay well away from this vets, they only care about money, they confused you, scared you and are truly dishonest! The prices are completely outrageous!!!in the other hand check out Celia Hammond Animal Trust which will take great care of any pet that needs help regardless. Such a great organisation caring for the welfare of your pets at very affordable prices :)!

To the reply from Wolfe Vets; I am not sure what is this “financial agreement that suits us” when I paid you £650 for two days painkillers !!!!! At no point there was a clear price list showed to us. Either way, it looks like I am not the only one reviewing you in regards of your dishonest behaviour and money grabbing….. not cool at all!
Very clean lovely staff and fantastic vets and nurses they treat all furbabies as there own i would highly recommend them
Thank you for your review.

Wolfe Vets saved our cat on Monday. We called them in the evening and brought him to the emergency room. The team performed emergency surgery on him straight away and called us a few hours later to keep us informed. Our little guy stayed as an inpatient for 2 days, and he was really well looked after. He received lots of love and care, and I was even able to visit him during his stay! The team called me twice a day to keep me posted, which was really comforting. We can’t thank them enough and we feel reassured that we have such a great 24/7 vet so close to us. Thanks again for saving our baby ❤️

I only have good things to say about this vets, and my dog loves visiting which says everything! It’s always really easy to get an appointment, super friendly and helpful reception staff and vets who clearly care and never rush, excellent treatment and great facilities. When my puppy had a bad experience with a dog in a local park and I took him in with a cut nose, after treatment the vet introduced him to her own puppy so that he’d have a nice experience with a dog and wouldn’t be scared to play.

Thank you for your review :)

Kind regards,
The team at Wolfe Vets

I had to bring my dog Java to the emergency vet after she ingested a tennis ball. Dr Alice Webb-Wilson was absolutely fantastic! She performed an endoscopic procedure and managed to retrieve the ball without needing surgery. This was the second time she’s treated Java, and both times she’s been incredibly skilled and kind.

Our cat was referred here because of gagging for a week. We were due for him to have scans and a possible endoscopy. Alonzo was the third vet to see him and immediately saw a grass blade lodged at the back of his throat,. He was then amazingly able to remove this manually with local anaesthetic without the need for invasive treatments. We were incredibly pleased, it saved a lot of pain for Bruce and money too. Service couldn’t have been better!
Thanks Sam for your review.

Wolfe Vets went above and beyond to help my Frenchie when he was poorly. The service was incredible, I was seen within 10 minutes. The team were calm, caring and professional, the best experience I have ever encountered by a London Vet.  I could not recommend highly enough that you take your dog to Wolfe Vets.
Thanks Nick for your review.

I would like to say that Wolfe Vets staff were fantastic and efficient. Our dog had a tick and the receptionist booked us in straight away and two veterinary nurses were able to remove it safely.  They were great

Dear John,

We do not have any record of you being registered with our clinic. Please let me know if this is incorrect or if you have brought a patient in that may be registered under another name. Feel free to contact the clinic directly if you have any concerns. Otherwise we will assume this feedback to be given in error.

Kind regards,
Annabelle
Client Services Manager
Wolfe Vets
All of my experiences with the Wolfe team have been amazing. I'm a first time dog mum and they've been patient but clear with me on all my questions.

We recently got referred to Wolfe vets Fulham, as our cat needed an endoscopy. Thankfully all went well and Koz has recovered well. All members of staff that were saw were lovely and they were so good with our anxious boy whilst he stayed with them.
Thank you to everyone for looking after our sweet boy Koz!

I think the questionnaire and the answers don’t give me enough options to express how happy and satisfied and loved we feel at wolfe vets! WE FEEL SAFE! Is big words these days, and says it all. On every occasion we are warmly welcomed, we get more than what we came for, advice, attitude, love, care, kindness. The nurses, the doctors, they bring that sense of calm the moment i step in with my Lula 🤍✨🫂🫶🏽

I took my 14 year old Dachshund to see Dr Minty at Wolfe vets Fulham. I thought I will never see him again dreading the worst case scenario . he was so poorly and so ill.
They did their utmost and their best to treat him for acute pancreatitis . Dr Karl did every test possible, to check that his organs were functioning properly in order,  to give the right medications. DR Minty, Dr Karl and Laura did their best of effort and care that I have ever seen in my life, to bring him back from the dead. he survived and now he is  behaving like a puppy , and not as a 14 year old.
I am so grateful to them, and will be so grateful for ever.
I wish them all the best, because they deserve the best.

Wolfe Vets have always taken great care of Teddy, my dog. The facilities are excellent and the people are highly skilled as well as being caring and friendly. All in all, not much more you could want.

Paid £300 to be seen less than 10minutes. When we asked questions about to administer a specific medicine, we were told to “read the instructions”. It took them 15 days to complete the insurance form after they had announced 10 days max.

My Rabbit got sick and he had to stay overnight for treatment and observation. His bunny friend was allowed to stay with him and the staff ( Claudia and Minty and all the nurses!) were so very lovely and kept me up to date and gave very clear after care instructions! Very grateful for all the help!
Thanks Emily for your review :)

We took our baby girl here for an emergency last Friday night. And after a brief check, it all felt so rushed and not cared for. There wasn’t any room for questions, and even when I asked how to use the probiotics that we were given, the vet simply answered it’s on the box and then she left. She wouldn’t bother to answer. Is this a joke? I’m appalled by this, considering they charge us more than £300. What is also unacceptable is that they took Lily to another room to give her an injection and the nurse could hold her. I’m sorry HRH The Nurse can surely come in the room… do these people know about animal care/compassion and trust? It is so important for pets in those moments to have the comfort of their owners. They are not toys. Thinking about the whole experience, it is a disgrace and surely unjustified prices.

I cannot thank the vets at Wolfe Vets enough for saving my kitten's life. She had some terrible complications from her spay, which was done at another vet. She was sent to Wolfe as an emergency and from the time we arrived until the time I took her home I knew that I was in the best possible hands. All the vets were wonderful but I would particularly like to thank Minty, who operated on her, and Roshni who took such good care of her each night that she was there.  I will be moving to Wolfe for all my vetinary care from now on. I really can't recommend them highly enough.

Registered my very nervous cat. Nice enough experience apart from having to insist on a few things that seemed obvious to me (like having someone take blood in the same room rather than take him into another room whilst he was TERRIFIED). I got a huge bill for a blood test and some very basic advice. Settled straight away and was on my way. No real follow-up like I am used to having at my previous vets on Munster Rd. I then emailed 8 weeks later as had a request for flea treatment (which is the reason I had taken him in the first place) and was ignored. Had a junior person call me to make another appointment despite me already explaining why this wasn't possible. In sum this is an efficient practice (they are excellent when it comes to balancing the books) that is run by enthusiastic junior vets. I am returning to my old vets for a more compassionate experience. The only reason I switched is because this is walkable with the cat carrier so less stress for scared kitty.

EDIT. The reply below makes NO sense because the practice called me to say I could collect the flea product afterall.
So a breakdown of team communication has occured. One saying I needed an appointment and another saying I didn't. When i arrived to collect the treatment I asked the proce before payiong.  $62 (pounds). The exact same product online with courier deliveery was $22. My advice is to check online before you pay these rip-off prices from vet surgeries. I got the treatment online and am de-registering my cat. This practice is about making money, not about caring for animals. I understand it's not a charirty but honestly, this is daylight robbery.
Very good doctors and service!
Just a great and friendly staff and the vets are good
Thanks for your review Shahram.

Big thanks to Dr Alonso and the team at Wolfe Vets. We were booked in quickly for the following day, and received prompt action and helpful insights at our appointment. Dr Alonso was calm and reassuring. Highly recommend!
Rather expensive but convenient for out of hours emergencies.

We brought our very ill cat, Wispa, to Wolfe Vets in Fulham after struggling with a complicated intestinal issue and receiving inadequate support from our previous vet. From the moment we arrived in a desperate state, Dr. Leo and Dr. Dupuy  were incredible. Their approach was focused and decisive—there was no “hoping and waiting”; every procedure had a clear purpose and goal.

The night vet, Claudia, showed exceptional compassion, keeping us constantly updated on Wispa’s condition and progress. It was clear that our beloved pet was in the best possible hands to recover.

The level of communication and transparency was outstanding. There were no hidden costs or unexpected charges. Most importantly, our pet wasn’t treated as just another case number—Wolfe Vets truly cared about Wispa’s well-being.

The quiet private car parking around the back is also great, not having to mess about trying to find parking with a poorly animal was appreciated.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Leo, Dr. Dupuy, Claudia, and the entire Wolfe Vets team for your dedication and compassion. We’re deeply grateful for everything you’ve done.

Wonderful vet practice with fantastic facilities and lovely vets. I was referred to Wolfe Vets when my Dog had mysterious symptoms and was in a lot of discomfort suddenly, they brought him in immediately and set to work with tests and treatment to figure out what was wrong. Alonso was fantastic at explaining each step of the process and what it all meant, calling me with regular updates throughout. Claudia even called me through the night and first thing in the morning from the night shift to also update me which was amazing. My dog is usually fairly nervous aggressive in such situations, but the team were so lovely and put him at ease that he was really happy and well behaved. He responded well and quickly to the treatment provided - thank you so much to the team!

This practice which is new to Fulham but with their original in Chiswick is outstanding. They have their own operating theatre, ambulance and do all their tests in house so results are with you the same day. My dog almost died from liver problems and their expertise saved his life. Most professional and friendly unlike other Fulham vets probably because they are independent and not part of a chain.
Allan Kelly

All vets are expensive, particularly when you have no insurance, but Wolfe Vets have a great "Wolfe Pack" membership for basics which helps reduce cost.

The vets have always provided excellent care and advice and stear away from expensive procedures and unnescesary vists/costs.

This practice instills confidence in me as a client and is worth every penny.

I have to start by saying that I was not a regular Wolfe Vets clients, so I cannot speak of their regular services. However, I am very lucky to have them around 2mins away from my house.

My beloved dog very quickly went from being a bit down, to suddenly beginning to leave us (he had a mast cell tumour) As luck has it, my regular vet, with whom I had a plan in place for this moment, was on holiday, so I needed to either find someone at our practice who could come home or elsewhere. I showed up as soon as they were opening to ask if someone could come over to help my dog cross over. I got a call back straight away saying they would, exactly at the time I needed it to be.

Although it was probably the worst circumstances to meet someone, Dr. Alonso was incredibly kind and compassionate. He and I believe it was nurse Alice arrived promptly, prepped Bruno with care and explained everything, giving me enough time as I wished to say good bye.

The only reason I give 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the extortionate price for this (over £400) My initial vet had quoted £130 for an at-home euthanasia visit, and even the mobile vets out of hours fee is around £360 for a dog my size. Had I known this ahead of time, I would have done so in the middle of the night to avoid further suffering to my dog rather than wait until opening hours.

Beyond that, know that the team at Wolfe’s is kind, compassionate and prompt to act.

Thank you for your review :)

Kind regards,
The team at Wolfe Vets
